1. Find the total sales amount handled by each Sales Person in 2024, including:
● Employee Full Name
● Territory Name
● Total Sales Amount
● Total Orders Count
● Average Order Amount

SELECT
    TRIM(CONCAT(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName + ' ', ''), AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName)) AS [Employee Full Name],
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesTerritory.Name AS [Territory Name],
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS [Total Sales Amount],
    COUNT(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID) AS [Total Orders Count],
    AVG(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS [Average Order Amount]
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesPerson
ON
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesPersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesPerson.BusinessEntityID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person
ON
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesPerson.BusinessEntityID = AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.BusinessEntityID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesTerritory
ON
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesPerson.TerritoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesTerritory.TerritoryID
WHERE
    YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) = 2024
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.BusinessEntityID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesTerritory.Name
ORDER BY
    [Employee Full Name];

Show all products with Category, Subcategory, Color, Size, List Price, Units Sold, Total
Revenue, Inventory Quantity, and Reorder Level. Use tables: Production.Product,
Production.ProductSubcategory, Production.ProductCategory, Production.ProductInventory,
Sales.SalesOrderDetail.

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS Category,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name AS Subcategory,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Color,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Size,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ListPrice AS "List Price",
    ISNULL(SUM(CAST(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty AS INT)), 0) AS "Units Sold",
    ISNULL(SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal), 0) AS "Total Revenue",
    ISNULL(SUM(CAST(AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.Quantity AS INT)), 0) AS "Inventory Quantity",
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ReorderPoint AS "Reorder Level"
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.ProductID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID, -- Group by ProductID to ensure each distinct product is a row
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name, -- Include Product.Name in GROUP BY to ensure unique product rows.
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Color,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Size,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ListPrice,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ReorderPoint
ORDER BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name

Show all orders with Order Date, Ship Date, Customer, Product, Quantity, Total Due,
Shipping Method, and Order Status. Include total revenue by shipping method and top 10
customers. Use tables: Sales.SalesOrderHeader, Sales.SalesOrderDetail, Sales.Customer,
Production.Product, Sales.ShipMethod.

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipDate,
    CASE
        WHEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN
            LTRIM(RTRIM(
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.Title + ' ', '') +
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName, '') + ' ' +
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName + ' ', '') +
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName, '') +
                ISNULL(' ' + AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.Suffix, '')
            ))
        WHEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID IS NOT NULL THEN
            AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name
        ELSE 'Unknown Customer'
    END AS Customer_Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS Product_Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty AS Quantity,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue,
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name AS Shipping_Method,
    CASE AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.Status
        WHEN 1 THEN 'In process'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Approved'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Backordered'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Rejected'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Shipped'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Cancelled'
        ELSE 'Unknown Status'
    END AS Order_Status
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN -- A customer can be an individual person
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.BusinessEntityID
LEFT JOIN -- A customer can be a store
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.BusinessEntityID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipMethodID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.ShipMethodID;

-- Total revenue by shipping method
SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name AS Shipping_Method,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS Total_Revenue_by_Shipping_Method
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipMethodID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.ShipMethodID
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name
ORDER BY
    Total_Revenue_by_Shipping_Method DESC;

-- Top 10 customers by total revenue
SELECT TOP 10
    CASE
        WHEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN
            LTRIM(RTRIM(
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.Title + ' ', '') +
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName, '') + ' ' +
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName + ' ', '') +
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName, '') +
                ISNULL(' ' + AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.Suffix, '')
            ))
        WHEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID IS NOT NULL THEN
            AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name
        ELSE 'Unknown Customer'
    END AS Customer_Name,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS Total_Customer_Revenue
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.BusinessEntityID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.BusinessEntityID
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID,
    CASE
        WHEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID IS NOT NULL THEN
            LTRIM(RTRIM(
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.Title + ' ', '') +
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName, '') + ' ' +
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName + ' ', '') +
                ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName, '') +
                ISNULL(' ' + AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.Suffix, '')
            ))
        WHEN AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID IS NOT NULL THEN
            AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name
        ELSE 'Unknown Customer'
    END
ORDER BY
    Total_Customer_Revenue DESC;

Show suppliers with their products name, unit cost, total units purchased, total
purchase cost, and product category. Include top 10 suppliers by purchase
volume.

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.Name AS VendorName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS ProductName,
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS TotalUnitsPurchased,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS TotalPurchaseCost,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS ProductCategoryName
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.BusinessEntityID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader.PurchaseOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.PurchaseOrderID
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
WHERE
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.BusinessEntityID IN (
        SELECT TOP 10 SubQueryVendor.BusinessEntityID
        FROM (
            SELECT
                AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.BusinessEntityID,
                SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS SupplierTotalVolume
            FROM
                AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor
            JOIN
                AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.BusinessEntityID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID
            JOIN
                AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail ON AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader.PurchaseOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.PurchaseOrderID
            GROUP BY
                AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.BusinessEntityID
        ) AS SubQueryVendor
        ORDER BY
            SubQueryVendor.SupplierTotalVolume DESC
    )
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.Vendor.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name,
    AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail.UnitPrice,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name
ORDER BY
    VendorName, TotalPurchaseCost DESC

Show all products with Category, Subcategory, Color, Size, List Price, Units Sold, Total
Revenue, Inventory Quantity, and Reorder Level. Use tables: Production.Product,
Production.ProductSubcategory, Production.ProductCategory, Production.ProductInventory,
Sales.SalesOrderDetail.

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.Name AS Category,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.Name AS Subcategory,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Color,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Size,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ListPrice,
    ISNULL(SalesSummary.UnitsSold, 0) AS UnitsSold,
    ISNULL(SalesSummary.TotalRevenue, 0) AS TotalRevenue,
    ISNULL(InventorySummary.InventoryQuantity, 0) AS InventoryQuantity,
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ReorderPoint
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductSubcategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryID
LEFT JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductCategory.ProductCategoryID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty) AS UnitsSold,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenue
    FROM
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
    GROUP BY
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID
) AS SalesSummary ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = SalesSummary.ProductID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.ProductID,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.Quantity) AS InventoryQuantity
    FROM
        AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory
    GROUP BY
        AdventureWorks2022.Production.ProductInventory.ProductID
) AS InventorySummary ON AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID = InventorySummary.ProductID

Shipping Method, and Order Status. Include total revenue by shipping method and top 10
customers. Use tables: Sales.SalesOrderHeader, Sales.SalesOrderDetail, Sales.Customer,
Production.Product, Sales.ShipMethod.

WITH AllOrderDetails AS (
    SELECT
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate AS [Order Date],
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipDate AS [Ship Date],
        COALESCE(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName + ' ', '') + AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName, AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name) AS Customer,
        AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS Product,
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.OrderQty AS Quantity,
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue AS [Total Due],
        AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name AS [Shipping Method],
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.Status AS [Order Status],
        'Order Detail' AS Source_Type
    FROM
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
    INNER JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
    INNER JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID
    LEFT JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.BusinessEntityID
    LEFT JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.BusinessEntityID
    INNER JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
    INNER JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipMethodID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.ShipMethodID
),
RevenueByShippingMethod AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS datetime) AS [Order Date],
        CAST(NULL AS datetime) AS [Ship Date],
        CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(MAX)) AS Customer,
        CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(MAX)) AS Product,
        CAST(NULL AS smallint) AS Quantity,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS [Total Due],
        AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name AS [Shipping Method],
        CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS [Order Status],
        'Total Revenue by Shipping Method' AS Source_Type
    FROM
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
    INNER JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipMethodID = AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.ShipMethodID
    GROUP BY
        AdventureWorks2022.Purchasing.ShipMethod.Name
),
Top10CustomersRevenue AS (
    SELECT TOP 10
        CAST(NULL AS datetime) AS [Order Date],
        CAST(NULL AS datetime) AS [Ship Date],
        COALESCE(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName + ' ', '') + AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName, AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name) AS Customer,
        CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(MAX)) AS Product,
        CAST(NULL AS smallint) AS Quantity,
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS [Total Due],
        CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(MAX)) AS [Shipping Method],
        CAST(NULL AS tinyint) AS [Order Status],
        'Top 10 Customers' AS Source_Type
    FROM
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
    INNER JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.CustomerID
    LEFT JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.PersonID = AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.BusinessEntityID
    LEFT JOIN
        AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store
        ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Customer.StoreID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.BusinessEntityID
    GROUP BY
        COALESCE(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.MiddleName + ' ', '') + AdventureWorks2022.Person.Person.LastName, AdventureWorks2022.Sales.Store.Name)
    ORDER BY
        SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) DESC
)
SELECT
    [Order Date],
    [Ship Date],
    Customer,
    Product,
    Quantity,
    [Total Due],
    [Shipping Method],
    [Order Status],
    Source_Type
FROM
    AllOrderDetails

UNION ALL

SELECT
    [Order Date],
    [Ship Date],
    Customer,
    Product,
    Quantity,
    [Total Due],
    [Shipping Method],
    [Order Status],
    Source_Type
FROM
    RevenueByShippingMethod

UNION ALL

SELECT
    [Order Date],
    [Ship Date],
    Customer,
    Product,
    Quantity,
    [Total Due],
    [Shipping Method],
    [Order Status],
    Source_Type
FROM
    Top10CustomersRevenue
ORDER BY
    Source_Type DESC, -- Orders aggregate types first ('Top 10 Customers', 'Total Revenue by Shipping Method', then 'Order Detail')
    Customer,
    [Order Date];
